description: Sends or shares a workbook: email it to its members or named people (`email`, `send_to`); show, create or rotate its share link (`link`); or copy every web source it cites into the connected drive (`save_sources`).

email.description: true to email it to its members (or `send_to`).

link.description: show, create or rotate the share link. Default show.

preview.description: With `email`: only say who it would go to.

save_sources.description: true to copy every web source it cites into the drive.

send_to.description: Members' emails to send to. Omit for all of them. An address that is not a member is not mailed.

name: share_workbook
title: Send or share a workbook
